answer: In a Proof of Agent network, each identity is verified by a VDF requiring a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings, while a Wesolowski proof enables efficient verification. A sable anchor binds the result to its claimant; a raven-like attacker creating many clones must complete one independent chain per clone. GPUs can run chains separately, but cannot parallelize dependencies within a chain, imposing a strict physical time bottleneck.
